settings.rules: Classic Era (wowsims/classic: level 60, vanilla talents and ranks, no runes; content through Naxxramas, IncludeAQ = true so AQ ranks such as Heroic Strike rank 9 are used)
settings.target: the sim's "Level 60" preset boss: level 63, 3731 armor, 1 target
settings.presets: each spec's own UI defaults (ui/<spec>/presets.ts and sim.ts): DefaultGear, DefaultTalents, DefaultAPL(s), DefaultConsumes, raid/party/individual buffs, debuffs, spec options, race, professions; tanks are in front of the target and listed as the raid tank
settings.deviations: listed per spec under run.deviations (borrowed gear where the preset is blank or has no weapon, derived APLs or talents where the sim has no preset)

fields.abilities[].casts: casts per minute (average over iterations; for procs and dots this is 0 and hitsPerMinute is given instead)
fields.abilities[].damageShare: share of the player's own damage (pets excluded; pet share is under pets)
fields.abilities[].threatShare: tank specs only (null otherwise): share of the player's total threat (all actions, including rage and mana gain threat)
fields.abilities[].ids: WoWSims action ids: spell:<id>, item:<id> or other:<OtherAction>; #n is the action tag (1 = queue press of a next-swing strike, for white hits 1 = main hand, 2 = off hand, 3 = extra attacks)
fields.swings.mainHand.perMinute: main-hand white swings that actually happened as white hits (swings replaced by next-swing strikes are not in it)
fields.swings.replacedByNextSwingStrikes: per minute, main-hand swings consumed by Heroic Strike / Cleave / Maul / Raptor Strike (each strike that goes off, landed or not)
fields.swings.mainHandSwingTimerTotal: white main-hand swings + replaced swings per minute (extra attacks excluded)

Execute.note: the sim meters this ability under a passive spell without casts; casts = landed + missed attempts

Rage gain.note: resource bookkeeping (threat from resource gains), not an ability

Heroic Strike (queue).note: APL queue presses of the next-swing strike; the strike itself is the row without "(queue)"

extraAttacks.note: extra main-hand swings from procs (Windfury, Hand of Justice, sword specialization, ...); they do not reset into next-swing strikes

nextSwingVsWhite.note: netGainDamageShare = (strike damage - replaced swings x average main-hand white damage per swing) / total damage: the damage the strikes add over the white swings they consume
